title: Our Cat Brings Home WARM Shoes 🐈
description:
Every night our cat carries a pair of shoes in through the flap. Work boots one night, one tap shoe the next. They're always still warm, and nobody in town ever comes for them.

Dad says the cat goes on Saturday. And all week, someone has been walking one streetlight behind him on his way home.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MEOW if you'd let it walk you home.
